tournament.name: 2022年度 ジャパンジュニアプレーヤーズチャンピオンシップ西日本決勝大会 15歳～18歳男子の部
tournament.name_en: 2022 Japan Junior Players Championship West Japan final, Boys Ages 15-18
tournament.organizer: 日本ジュニアゴルフ協会 (JJGA)

issues: Parsed programmatically from the JJGA result PDF (pdfplumber word positions); every OUT+IN pair and every round total checked against the printed round and total columns.
JJGA results print no school names: school is null and school_prefecture is the printed 所在地 column (the player's registered prefecture, not necessarily the school's).
grade = the circled ①-③ printed in the 15-18 division, taken as the high-school year (JJGA's 12-14 division lists junior-high ①-③).
Ties are written as T-ranks (JJGA prints shared positions as plain numbers); to_par computed from the printed par and holes played.
PDF note: ※18ホール短縮プレーになりました (event shortened to one 18-hole round).
